title: U.S. Courts caseload statistics: federal court and bankruptcy filings, terminations and pending cases
agency: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
questions: bankruptcy filings by chapter and district
civil and criminal cases filed in federal district courts
appeals filed, terminated and pending by circuit

manual.how: Open https://www.uscourts.gov/statistics-reports/caseload-statistics-data-tables, filter to the table, click 'Download xlsx', and upload the workbook with ingest.

cache.why: Tables are published quarterly; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: Judiciary statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts, {dataset}, uscourts.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which period? Most tables cover a 12-month period ending March 31, June 30, September 30 or December 31 (the file name carries the end date); some cover 1 or 3 months. Default: the latest 12-month table, with the same period a year earlier.

Which series? Bankruptcy filings (bf_), Statistical Tables for the Federal Judiciary (stfj_), Federal Judicial Caseload Statistics and Judicial Business: they repeat some tables for different periods. Default: the series whose period matches the question.
aliases: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
